Class RegionPack

java.lang.Object
org.roux.spill.RegionPack
@Component public class RegionPack extends Object
The RegionPack is the random-access pages.bin file for one region. Slot P starts at P times the page size from the settings. publishPage(String, Page) writes the used bytes, pads to the alignment, and forces the channel. A page publish waits until the force returns for the one copy on this disk. The page stays mapped. One channel stays open per region. A bound segment names the live pack folder, and the lock file stays on the username directory. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RegionPack roux-v1.md

    • bindFolder

      public void bindFolder(String regionId, String folderSegment)
      The method stores the live pack segment for one region. A null segment stores the region id. An empty segment stores the region id. The lock file is not moved.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the username.
      folderSegment - The segment is the live folder name, or empty for the username folder.

    • packDir

      public Path packDir(String regionId)
      The method returns the live pack directory. An unbound region returns the username directory. A bound region returns the spill root plus the stored segment. The lock directory is not this path.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the username.
      Returns:
      The path is the live pack directory.

    • isEnabled

      public boolean isEnabled()
      The method reports whether spill is enabled. A missing spill block returns false.
      Returns:
      The flag is true when a publish may write.

    • regionDir

      public Path regionDir(String regionId)

      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name under that directory.
      Returns:
      The path is the region directory.

    • tryLock

      public boolean tryLock(String regionId)
      The method tries to take an exclusive lock on .lock. A lock this process already holds returns true. The directory is created when it is absent. An overlapping lock returns false. A lock that another process holds returns false. An input-output error returns false.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.
      Returns:
      The flag is true when this process holds the lock.

    • unlock

      public void unlock(String regionId)
      The method releases the exclusive lock. A region with no lock is left unchanged. An error while releasing or closing is ignored.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.

    • wipePack

      public void wipePack(String regionId)
      The method deletes pages.bin, manifest.bin, and manifest.bin.tmp. The directory stays. The lock stays. The open pack channel is closed first. An input-output error is ignored.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.

    • slotOffset

      public long slotOffset(int pageId)
      The method returns the file offset of one page slot. The offset is the page id times the page size from the settings.
      Parameters:
      pageId - The page id is the slot number.
      Returns:
      The offset is the first byte of that slot.

    • publishPage

      public void publishPage(String regionId, Page page) throws IOException
      The method writes one page into its slot. A page with no mapped bytes throws IOException with page has no RAM segment. The checksum is written first. The used bytes are padded up to the alignment, and not past the page size. A missing spill block, or an alignment of 1 or less, uses 4096. The count is read before any byte is written. The channel is still forced before the method returns. The page stays mapped. A write that returns a negative count throws IOException with pack write EOF. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RegionPack roux-v1.md spillover-semantics.md
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.
      page - The page is the page with a live segment.
      Throws:
      IOException - The page has no mapped bytes, the copy count is below 1, or the write failed.

      public byte[] readRange(String regionId, int pageId, int offsetInPage, int length) throws IOException

    • deleteRegion

      public void deleteRegion(String regionId)
      The method closes the pack channel, releases the lock, and deletes the region directory. A missing directory returns without an error. An input-output error is ignored.

    • open

      private FileChannel open(String regionId) throws IOException
      The method returns the open channel for pages.bin. An open channel is reused. The directory is created when it is absent.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.
      Returns:
      The channel is the open file.
      Throws:

    • releaseSlot

      public void releaseSlot(String regionId, int pageId, boolean tail) throws IOException
      The method releases one slot. A tail slot is truncated back to the slot offset. Any other slot is written as zeros and then punched. The logical length of a hole stays. A punch that fails leaves the zeros in place. The channel is forced before the method returns.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.
      pageId - The page id is the slot to release.
      tail - The flag is true when the slot end is the file length.
      Throws:
      IOException - The truncate, the zero write, or the force failed.

    • punch

      private void punch(String regionId, long offset, long beyond)
      The method marks the pack sparse and punches one range. The first hole in this process marks the file sparse. A failed call leaves the zeros that were already written.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.
      offset - The offset is the first byte of the hole.
      beyond - The beyond value is the first byte after the hole.
